# Corvint

> Corvint gives a coding agent Git-pinned evidence about a repository: what governs it, what a
> change reaches (`corvint impact`), which tests the change needs (`corvint affected`), and what
> each diff hunk rests on (Change Evidence Map, `cem/1.0`). Every answer names its Git blob,
> authority and reason, and missing evidence is reported as unknown. Corvint Tasks
> (`corvint-tasks`) is a local ticket queue with claims and gated completion, and stdio MCP
> servers and host adapters expose the same receipts to agents. It is one local native-Go binary
> with no account or network dependency. This file is the single entry point for an
> LLM that has never seen Corvint. Every command, flag and MCP tool is reachable from the links
> below, and `tools/capabilities-check` fails the tests when a new one ships without its help and
> catalog entry (CAP-V0-040 to CAP-V0-050).

## Start here

- [Capability catalog](docs/CAPABILITIES.md): every `corvint` command, every binary built from
  `cmd/` and every MCP tool, with the smallest call, maturity and refusals
- `corvint help guide`: the task-indexed guide with runnable examples and the tracked
  non-capabilities ([source](internal/capcatalog/AGENT-GUIDE.md))
- `corvint help`: the compact verb index; `corvint COMMAND --help` (or `-h`) at any depth prints
  that command's usage, flags, required inputs and an example and exits 0

## Machine-readable catalogs

- `corvint help --json`: the `corvint-capability-catalog/0` command catalog
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/catalog.json)); its `commandTrees` member links every command tree
- `corvint help --tree`: corvint's `corvint-command-tree/0` tree, every subcommand at every depth
  with its flags ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint.json))
- `corvint-cem-candidate help --json`: the CEM candidate companion's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-cem-candidate.json))
- `corvint-cem-experiments help --json`: the CEM criterion experiment companion's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-cem-experiments.json))
- `corvint-corpus-republish help --json`: the trusted-local corpus republish companion's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-corpus-republish.json))
- `corvint-dashboard-snapshot help --json`: the dashboard snapshot compiler's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-dashboard-snapshot.json))
- `corvint-gateway help --json`: the experimental loopback model gateway's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-gateway.json))
- `corvint-go-test-provider help --json`: the Go live-test provider's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-go-test-provider.json))
- `corvint-intake help --json`: the local intake validator's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-intake.json))
- `corvint-js-test-provider help --json`: the JavaScript test provider's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-js-test-provider.json))
- `corvint-postmerge-connect help --json`: the post-merge connector's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-postmerge-connect.json))
- `corvint-postmerge-metrics help --json`: the post-merge metrics report's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-postmerge-metrics.json))
- `corvint-postmerge-workflow help --json`: the post-merge replay companion's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-postmerge-workflow.json))
- `corvint-pulse help --json`: the Pulse stdio server's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-pulse.json))
- `corvint-ruby-test-provider help --json`: the Ruby test provider's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-ruby-test-provider.json))
- `corvint-tasks help --json`: the task store CLI's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-tasks.json))
- `corvint-test help --json`: the test companion's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-test.json))
- `corvint-update help --json`: the official release updater's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-update.json))
- `corvint-work-queue help --json`: the read-only work-queue observation producer's tree
  ([snapshot](internal/capcatalog/trees/corvint-work-queue.json))
